# Gizmo AI Unlimited

> A free, open-source browser extension for unlimited hearts, unlocked hints, and unlimited Magic Imports on Gizmo AI (app.gizmo.ai). It removes Magic Import's client-side cooldown without bypassing server-side limits.

## What it does
- Removes the "out of hearts" modal on app.gizmo.ai/quiz so practice is unlimited.
- Unlocks every hint, which is normally gated behind a paid Gizmo subscription.
- Enables unlimited Magic Imports by disabling the client-side cooldown check; any server-side limits remain outside the extension's scope.
- Activates automatically when Gizmo opens; no settings, no account, no setup.

## Key facts
- Price: Free, forever. No paid tier.
- Privacy: Zero personal data collected. No cookies, localStorage, analytics, or telemetry. All patching happens locally in the browser.
- Open source: Full source on GitHub at https://github.com/alexey-max-fedorov/gizmo-ai-unlimited
- Self-healing: Patch rules refresh every 2 hours, so it keeps working after Gizmo updates.
- Browsers: Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, and Firefox.
- Not affiliated with Gizmo AI.

## Install
- Chrome / Brave: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/jnbnbecephjaglcnfhmpopikchhifgnh
- Microsoft Edge: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/gizmo-ai-unlimited/gajdekhpddjnkkldabhaahhhanmkkegi
- Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/gizmo-ai-unlimited/
